_comment: Thresholds and knobs for tools/usage. warn/hold/sample_stale_minutes were approved by Jacob on 2026-10-05 (PLAN-usage-reporting.md §8); they move only from evidence: `usage calibrate` prints a proposal, and a change here is a commit a person reads. size_tokens (2026-10-09, PLAN-architecture-review.md item 7) is the token estimate `usage gate --todo` gives a todo item of each size, an unmeasured first value: L and unsized items get none. Every key is read by usagelib through config.setting(), and tests/test_config.py fails if a key is unread or a read key is missing.
